candidates.label: Table lineage
candidates.lead: Reported PDF crop defects and parser limitations
candidates.input: Five-page original synthetic survey PDF; all table values visible
candidates.output: Two tables in JSON: cells, page attribution, notes and fragment boxes
candidates.reference: Private author transcription and content-envelope geometry
candidates.limit: Fixed-document curation permits manual transcription. It does not test authentic vector-diagram crop ownership.

candidates.label: Chat recovery
candidates.lead: Resident exit, queued work and stale-scope reports
candidates.source_strength: Recovered lifecycle evidence; exact timeout incident missing
candidates.input: Timestamped simulated events, public semantics and one example
candidates.output: JSON state, idempotent effects and per-room lifecycle views
candidates.reference: Private deterministic schedules and expected checkpoints
candidates.limit: No real messaging connection, wall clock or external availability. The recalled verdict-timeout/reroute incident was not recovered.

candidates.label: Annotation QA
candidates.source_strength: Explicit new proposal; not a recovered benchmark failure
candidates.input: CT + BINARY SEG, full vocabulary and requested focus labels
candidates.output: Exact missing / wrong-side / misplaced finding sets
candidates.reference: Private controlled mutations and clean/partial-coverage controls
candidates.limit: Five correlated packets from one CT; gross QA only. No public anatomical rule list; no clinical certification.

candidates.label: Patient-plane SVG
candidates.lead: User-recalled SVG difficulty; original incident not recovered
candidates.source_strength: Recollection inspires a separately specified fixture
candidates.input: Tilted CT + sparse SEG, four LPS queries and exact sampling rules
candidates.output: Axial, coronal and sagittal SVGs at each query
candidates.reference: Private masks computed from original NIfTI geometry
candidates.limit: Supplied-mask resampling, not unaided anatomy drawing. Shares the source CT with H03; raster SVG is permitted.

candidates.label: Vector crop ownership
candidates.lead: Original diagram boundary versus surrounding prose
candidates.source_strength: Recovered crop reports; authentic compact fixture absent
candidates.input: Authentic vector figure with nearby prose remains to be curated
candidates.output: Complete diagram boundary excluding unrelated prose
candidates.reference: Independent boundary truth remains to be established
candidates.limit: Parked source lead. No authored executable task or model result in this round.
